facts.value: We are a small practice, which means you’ll meet and deal directly with one of our experienced designer directors. We’ve got a range of skills and experience between us, which we can pool to adapt quickly to the specific needs of your project . We make sure that the design process remains transparent to you, your collaborators and stakeholders, encouraging engagement and collaboration in the creative process. Let’s get started! Tom is an all rounder, our Director with a strong interest in technology, culture and community. A formative architectural experience came during time spent in Chile, where he discovered a deep appreciation of both the poetics and materiality of building. After finishing his architectural studies with a specialism in building reuse, Tom joined the in-house architectural practice at English Heritage. A PhD followed, in the practice and theory of designing, building, and buying houses made of steel. Tom is also Director of Sneinton Alchemy , a community interest company working to support his (and 2hD’s) home neighbourhood.
